name: Acid Splash
description: Acid bursts in a {{distance:5ft|adj}}-radius Sphere within {{distance:60ft}}. Creatures there make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 Acid damage. Damage becomes 2d6, 3d6, and 4d6 at character levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack. A hit deals 1d10 Necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining Hit Points until the end of your next turn. Damage rises to 2d10, 3d10, and 4d10 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Dancing Lights
description: Create up to four hovering Dim Lights, each illuminating a {{distance:10ft|adj}} radius, or combine them into one Medium humanoid shape. As a Bonus Action, move the lights up to {{distance:60ft}}, keeping them within {{distance:20ft}} of one another.

name: Druidcraft
description: Produce a small nature effect: predict the next day's local weather, make a plant bloom, create a harmless sensory effect, or light or extinguish a candle, torch, or campfire.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: Make a ranged spell attack with each beam. A hit deals 1d10 Force damage. Create two beams at level 5, three at level 11, and four at level 17; choose targets separately and roll each attack separately.

name: Elementalism
description: Create a minor elemental effect within {{distance:30ft}}: stir air or dust, make a word appear in sand, produce harmless smoke or embers, or briefly shape, color, or move water.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object. A hit deals 1d10 Fire damage and ignites unattended flammable objects. Damage rises to 2d10, 3d10, and 4d10 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature and choose one skill. For up to 1 minute, it adds 1d4 to ability checks using that skill.

name: Light
description: Touch a Large or smaller unattended object. For 1 hour it sheds Bright Light for {{distance:20ft}} and Dim Light for {{distance:20ft|num}} more; an opaque cover blocks it.

name: Mage Hand
description: Create a spectral hand for 1 minute. It can manipulate objects, open unlocked doors or containers, and carry up to 10 pounds, but cannot attack or activate magic items.

name: Mending
description: Repair a single break or tear no larger than {{distance:1ft}} in an object you touch. It can physically mend a magic item but cannot restore its magic.

name: Message
description: Whisper to a creature within {{distance:120ft}}; only it hears you and can whisper a reply. Familiarity lets the message pass through barriers, but magical silence, sufficient solid material, or lead blocks it.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create a sound or an image of an object no larger than a {{distance:5ft|adj}} Cube for 1 minute. The image cannot produce sound, light, smell, or physical effects; a creature can discern it with a Study action and an Investigation check against your spell save DC.

name: Poison Spray
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within {{distance:30ft}}. A hit deals 1d12 Poison damage, rising to 2d12, 3d12, and 4d12 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Create a minor magical effect within {{distance:10ft}}: a harmless sensory effect, light or extinguish a small flame, clean or soil a small object, alter temperature or flavor, leave a mark, or make a tiny trinket. Up to three lasting effects can coexist.

name: Produce Flame
description: As a Bonus Action, create a flame that sheds Bright Light for {{distance:20ft}} and Dim Light for {{distance:20ft|num}} more for 10 minutes. During that time, a Magic action lets you hurl it up to {{distance:60ft}}; a ranged spell attack deals 1d8 Fire damage on a hit, rising at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Ray of Frost
description: Make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 Cold damage and reduces the target's Speed by {{distance:10ft}} until the start of your next turn. Damage rises to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Resistance
description: Touch a willing creature and choose Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. Once per turn, it reduces damage of that type by 1d4 for up to 1 minute.

name: Sacred Flame
description: A visible creature within {{distance:60ft}} makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Radiant damage; Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover do not help the save. Damage rises to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Shillelagh
description: Empower a held Club or Quarterstaff for 1 minute. Use your spellcasting ability for its melee attack and damage rolls; its damage die becomes d8, and damage can be Force instead of its normal type. The die becomes d10 at level 5, d12 at 11, and 2d6 at 17.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Make a melee spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 Lightning damage and prevents the target from making Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Sorcerous Burst
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object. A hit deals 1d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Psychic, or Thunder damage. Each damage die showing 8 can add another d8, up to your spellcasting modifier in extra dice. Base dice become 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Spare the Dying
description: A creature with 0 Hit Points that is not dead becomes Stable. Range is {{distance:15ft}}, doubling at levels 5, 11, and 17 to {{distance:30ft|num}}, {{distance:60ft|num}}, and {{distance:120ft}}.

name: Starry Wisp
description: Make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 Radiant damage; until the end of your next turn, the target sheds Dim Light for {{distance:10ft}} and cannot benefit from Invisible. Damage rises to 2d8, 3d8, and 4d8 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Create a minor wonder within {{distance:30ft}}, such as altered eyes, a booming voice that grants Advantage on Intimidation checks, changed flames, a door opening or closing, a phantom sound, or a tremor. Up to three lasting effects can coexist.

name: True Strike
material: a weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP
description: Make one attack with a proficient weapon worth at least 1 CP, using your spellcasting ability for its attack and damage rolls. Damage can be Radiant or the weapon's normal type, plus 1d6, 2d6, or 3d6 Radiant at levels 5, 11, or 17.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: A creature you see or hear within {{distance:60ft}} makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d6 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d6, 3d6, and 4d6 at levels 5, 11, and 17.

name: Alarm
description: Ward a door, window, or area up to a {{distance:20ft|adj}} Cube for 8 hours. Choose creatures that do not trigger it and whether an intruder causes a mental alert or an audible bell.

name: Animal Friendship
description: A Beast you can see makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is Charmed by you for 24 hours; the effect ends if you or an ally damages it. A higher-level slot adds one Beast per level.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Bane
description: Up to three visible creatures make Charisma saves. A failed target subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute. Each slot level above 1 adds one target.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Bless
description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute. Each slot level above 1 adds one target.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Burning Hands
description: Fire fills a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Cone from you. Creatures make Dexterity saves, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Unattended flammable objects ignite; higher slots add 1d6 damage per level.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6.

name: Charm Person
description: A visible Humanoid makes a Wisdom save, with Advantage if you or allies are fighting it. On a failure it is Charmed and Friendly for 1 hour, ending early if harmed by you or an ally; afterward it knows it was charmed.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Chromatic Orb
description: Make a ranged spell attack for 3d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage. Matching damage dice let the orb jump to another target within {{distance:30ft}}; with a higher slot, add 1d8 damage and allow up to as many jumps as the slot's level. No target can be hit twice.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d8.

name: Color Spray
description: Creatures in a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Cone make Constitution saves. Those that fail are Blinded until the end of your next turn.

name: Command
description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save against a one-word order. On failure, next turn it approaches you, drops what it holds, flees, falls Prone, or halts, according to your chosen command. Higher slots add targets.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Comprehend Languages
material: a pinch of soot and salt
description: For 1 hour, understand the literal meaning of spoken or signed language and of writing you touch. Reading a page takes about a minute; coded messages remain undeciphered.

name: Create or Destroy Water
material: a mix of water and sand
description: Create or remove up to 10 gallons of water in an open container, or create rain or disperse fog in a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Cube. Higher slots add 10 gallons or enlarge the Cube.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 10 gallons or increases the Cube's side by {{distance:5ft}}.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points. Each slot level above 1 adds 2d8 healing.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d8.

name: Detect Evil and Good
description: For up to 10 minutes, sense nearby Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead within {{distance:30ft}}, along with any active Hallow effect there. Thick barriers block the sense.

name: Detect Magic
description: For up to 10 minutes, sense magical effects within {{distance:30ft}}. A Magic action reveals visible magical auras and a spell's school; sufficiently thick barriers block detection.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
description: For up to 10 minutes, sense the location and kind of poisons, venomous or poisonous creatures, and magical contagions within {{distance:30ft}}. Thick barriers block detection.

name: Disguise Self
description: Change the apparent look of your body and carried equipment for 1 hour, within a roughly similar body plan. The illusion does not withstand physical inspection.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: A creature you see makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and uses its Reaction, if available, to flee safely; success halves the damage. Higher slots add 1d6.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6.

name: Divine Favor
description: For 1 minute, each hit with one of your weapon attacks deals an extra 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Divine Smite
castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Immediately after hitting with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend a Bonus Action to deal 2d8 extra Radiant damage; add 1d8 against a Fiend or Undead and 1d8 per slot level above 1.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d8.

name: Ensnaring Strike
castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon
description: Immediately after a weapon hit, vines force the target to make a Strength save. On failure it is Restrained for up to 1 minute and takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each turn until it escapes or the spell ends.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6.

name: Entangle
description: Plants fill a {{distance:20ft|adj}} square with Difficult Terrain for up to 1 minute. Creatures there when cast make Strength saves or become Restrained, with an action available to escape.

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: Dash when you cast this spell; for up to 10 minutes, you can Dash again as a Bonus Action on later turns.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Creatures in a {{distance:20ft|adj}} Cube that fail Dexterity saves glow for up to 1 minute. They cannot benefit from Invisibility, and visible attackers have Advantage against them.

name: False Life
description: Gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points. Each slot level above 1 grants 5 more Temporary Hit Points.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Feather Fall
castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls
material: a small feather or piece of down
description: As a Reaction when creatures fall, slow up to five falling creatures to {{distance:60ft}} per round for 1 minute. They take no falling damage if they land before it ends.

name: Find Familiar
material: burning incense worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Summon a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend spirit in the form of a CR 0 Beast. It acts independently and cannot attack; within {{distance:100ft}} you can communicate telepathically, see through its senses, or have it deliver a touch spell with its Reaction. You can dismiss and resummon it.

name: Floating Disk
description: Create a floating {{distance:3ft|adj}} disk that carries up to 500 pounds for 1 hour and follows when you move more than {{distance:20ft}} from it.

name: Fog Cloud
description: Create a Heavily Obscured {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius fog Sphere for up to 1 hour. Strong wind disperses it; each slot level above 1 increases its radius by {{distance:20ft}}.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 increases the fog's radius by {{distance:20ft}}.

name: Goodberry
description: Create ten magical berries lasting 24 hours. Eating one as a Bonus Action restores 1 Hit Point and supplies a day's nourishment.

name: Grease
material: a bit of pork rind or butter
description: Cover a {{distance:10ft|adj}} square with nonflammable grease for 1 minute, making it Difficult Terrain. Creatures there when it appears, or that enter or end a turn there, make Dexterity saves or fall Prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 4d6 Radiant damage and grants Advantage to the next attack against the target before the end of your next turn. Higher slots add 1d6.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature you can see within {{distance:60ft}} regains 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points. Each slot level above 1 adds 2d4 healing.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d4.

name: Hellish Rebuke
castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself
description: React after a visible creature within {{distance:60ft}} damages you. It makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 Fire damage on failure or half on success; higher slots add 1d10.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d10.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch is immune to Frightened and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each turn for up to 1 minute. Higher slots add targets.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Hex
material: the petrified eye of a newt
description: Curse a visible creature for up to 1 hour. Your hits with attack rolls deal 1d6 extra Necrotic damage to it, and it has Disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability. A Bonus Action can move the curse after it drops to 0 Hit Points.
higherLevels: A level 2 slot permits up to 4 hours of concentration, level 3-4 up to 8 hours, and level 5+ up to 24 hours.

name: Hideous Laughter
description: A visible creature that fails a Wisdom save falls Prone and becomes Incapacitated for up to 1 minute. It repeats the save after damage and at the end of each turn.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a visible creature for up to 1 hour. Your attack hits deal 1d6 extra Force damage to it, and you gain Advantage on Perception or Survival checks to find it. A Bonus Action can move the mark after the target drops to 0 Hit Points.
higherLevels: A level 3-4 slot permits up to 8 hours of concentration, and level 5+ up to 24 hours.

name: Ice Knife
material: a drop of water or a piece of ice
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature for 1d10 Piercing damage on a hit. Hit or miss, the shard bursts and the target and creatures within {{distance:5ft}} make Dexterity saves or take 2d6 Cold damage; higher slots increase the Cold damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6 Cold damage.

name: Identify
description: Touch an object during casting to learn its magical properties, attunement, charges, and active spells, or touch a creature to learn spells affecting it. Requires a pearl worth at least 100 GP.

name: Illusory Script
material: ink worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Write a message that designated readers see normally while others see unintelligible or misleading text for 10 days. The ink worth at least 10 GP is consumed.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: A creature you touch makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Each slot level above 1 adds 1d10.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d10.

name: Jump
description: A willing creature you touch can jump up to {{distance:30ft}} once on each turn by spending {{distance:10ft}} of movement for 1 minute. Higher slots add one target per level.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Longstrider
description: A creature you touch gains {{distance:10ft}} of Speed for 1 hour. Each slot level above 1 adds one target.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 allows one additional target.

name: Mage Armor
description: For 8 hours, an unarmored willing creature you touch has base AC 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. Donning armor ends the spell.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three darts of Force automatically strike visible creatures of your choice, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage. All strike simultaneously; higher slots create one extra dart per level.
higherLevels: Create one additional dart for each slot level above 1.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
material: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: For up to 10 minutes, a willing creature gains protection from Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead: their attacks have Disadvantage, and they cannot possess, Charm, or Frighten it.

name: Purify Food and Drink
description: Remove poison and rot from nonmagical food and drink in a {{distance:5ft|adj}}-radius Sphere within {{distance:10ft}}.

name: Ray of Sickness
description: Make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 2d8 Poison damage and Poisons the target until the end of your next turn; higher slots add 1d8 damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d8.

name: Sanctuary
material: a shard of glass from a mirror
description: Ward a creature for 1 minute. An attacker or caster targeting it must pass a Wisdom save or choose another target or lose the attempt. The ward ends if its subject attacks, casts a spell, or deals damage.

name: Searing Smite
castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Immediately after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 1d6 Fire damage. The target then takes 1d6 Fire damage at each turn's start until it succeeds on a Constitution save; higher slots increase both damages.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d6 to each damage roll.

name: Shield
castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell
description: React to a hit or Magic Missile to gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A creature within {{distance:60ft}} gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes while you concentrate.

name: Silent Image
description: Create a purely visual image up to a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Cube for up to 10 minutes. You can move it with a Magic action; physical interaction reveals the illusion.

name: Sleep
material: a pinch of sand or rose petals
description: Chosen creatures in a {{distance:5ft|adj}}-radius Sphere make Wisdom saves. Failure Incapacitates until the end of their next turn; a second failed save makes them Unconscious for up to 1 minute. Damage or shaking ends it; creatures that do not sleep automatically save.

name: Speak with Animals
description: For 10 minutes, understand and speak with Beasts, including using Influence with them and asking about nearby places or creatures.

name: Thunderwave
description: A {{distance:15ft|adj}} Cube of thunder erupts from you. Creatures make Constitution saves, taking 2d8 Thunder damage and being pushed {{distance:10ft}} on failure or half damage on success. Higher slots add 1d8 damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1d8.

name: Unseen Servant
material: a bit of string and of wood
description: Create an invisible, mindless force for 1 hour. It cannot attack but can carry out simple tasks you command with a Bonus Action.

name: Acid Arrow
description: Make a ranged spell attack against a target. A hit deals 4d4 Acid damage immediately and 2d4 more at the end of its next turn; a miss deals half the initial damage only. Higher slots add 1d4 to both damage rolls.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d4 to both damage rolls.

name: Aid
description: Up to three creatures within {{distance:30ft}} gain 5 to their current and maximum Hit Points for 8 hours. Each slot level above 2 adds another 5 Hit Points.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 5 to current and maximum Hit Points.

name: Alter Self
description: For up to 1 hour, choose aquatic adaptation (water breathing and Swim Speed), a changed appearance without altered statistics, or natural weapons that deal 1d6 damage using your spellcasting ability. A Magic action can change the option.

name: Animal Messenger
description: A Tiny CR 0 Beast that fails a Charisma save carries a message of up to 25 words toward a place you have visited. It travels about {{distance:25mi}} per day, or {{distance:50mi|num}} if it flies, for 24 hours; higher slots add 48 hours each.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 extends the duration by 48 hours.

name: Arcane Lock
material: gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Magically lock a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch until dispelled. Designated creatures or someone speaking your password can open it; casting consumes gold dust worth at least 25 GP.

name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
description: Place a false magical aura on an object or mask a willing creature's apparent type for 24 hours. Recasting on the same target daily for 30 days makes the illusion last until dispelled.

name: Augury
material: specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinatory tokens worth 25+ GP
description: Learn whether a course of action planned for the next 30 minutes is likely good, bad, mixed, or neutral. Each casting after the first before a Long Rest has a cumulative 25 percent chance to provide no answer.

name: Barkskin
description: A willing creature you touch has AC 17 whenever its normal AC would be lower for 1 hour.

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: A visible creature makes a Constitution save or becomes Blinded or Deafened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at each turn's end; higher slots add one target per level.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 allows one additional target.

name: Blur
description: For up to 1 minute, attackers have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you unless they perceive you with Blindsight or Truesight.

name: Calm Emotions
description: Humanoids in a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere make Charisma saves. On failure you can suppress their Charmed or Frightened conditions or make them Indifferent to creatures they were hostile toward for up to 1 minute.

name: Continual Flame
material: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Create a cool, fuel-free flame on an object that sheds bright light for {{distance:20ft}} and dim light for another {{distance:20ft}} until dispelled. Casting consumes ruby dust worth at least 50 GP.

name: Darkness
material: bat fur and a piece of coal
description: Create a {{distance:15ft|adj}}-radius Sphere of magical Darkness for up to 10 minutes, or center it on an unattended object. Ordinary light cannot illuminate it and Darkvision cannot see through it.

name: Darkvision
description: A willing creature you touch gains Darkvision out to {{distance:150ft}} for 8 hours.

name: Detect Thoughts
description: For up to 1 minute, sense thinking creatures nearby or read a visible creature's surface thoughts. A Magic action can switch effects; probing deeper requires a Wisdom save and alerts the target.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: A willing creature you touch can use a Magic action to breathe a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Creatures there make Dexterity saves against 3d6 damage, half on success; higher slots add 1d6.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Enhance Ability
description: A touched creature has Advantage on ability checks using one chosen ability other than Constitution for up to 1 hour. Higher slots add targets.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 allows one additional target.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
description: Enlarge or shrink a creature or unattended object for up to 1 minute; an unwilling creature can resist with a Constitution save. Size, weight, and weapon damage change accordingly.

name: Enthrall
description: Visible creatures you are not fighting make Wisdom saves or take a -10 penalty to Perception checks and Passive Perception for up to 1 minute.

name: Find Steed
description: Summon a loyal otherworldly steed in a space within {{distance:30ft}}. It uses the Otherworldly Steed stat block and can take Celestial, Fey, or Fiend form.
higherLevels: Use the spell slot's level for the steed's statistics.

name: Find Traps
description: Detect whether a deliberately created trap lies within {{distance:120ft}} and line of sight, and learn its general danger, but not its exact location.

name: Flame Blade
description: Conjure a fiery blade for up to 10 minutes. As a Magic action make a melee spell attack with it, dealing 3d6 Fire damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a hit; higher slots increase the damage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Flaming Sphere
description: Create a {{distance:5ft|adj}} fire sphere for up to 1 minute. Nearby creatures make Dexterity saves against 2d6 Fire damage, half on success; a Bonus Action moves the sphere and can force another save.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Gentle Repose
material: 2 Copper Pieces, which the spell consumes
description: Preserve a corpse or remains for 10 days, preventing decay and undeath. Time spent protected does not count against resurrection limits; the spell consumes two Copper Pieces.

name: Gust of Wind
description: A {{distance:60ft|adj}}-long, {{distance:10ft|adj}}-wide line of wind pushes creatures that fail Strength saves {{distance:15ft}} away and hinders movement toward you for up to 1 minute.

name: Heat Metal
material: a piece of iron and a flame
description: Heat a visible manufactured metal object for up to 1 minute. A creature touching it takes 2d8 Fire damage immediately and again when you use a Bonus Action on later turns.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Hold Person
description: A visible Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at each turn's end. Higher slots add one Humanoid per level.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 allows one additional target.

name: Invisibility
description: A touched creature becomes Invisible for up to 1 hour. Attacking, dealing damage, or casting a spell ends the effect early; higher slots add targets.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 allows one additional target.

name: Knock
description: Unlock or unbar one visible object within {{distance:60ft}}, including a magical lock, which is suppressed briefly. The opening produces a loud knock audible nearby.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: With a touch, end one condition on a creature: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Levitate
description: Raise one visible creature or loose object up to {{distance:20ft}} for up to 10 minutes. An unwilling creature can resist with a Constitution save; movement requires pulling against a surface.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
description: Name a kind of Beast, Plant creature, or nonmagical plant and learn the direction and distance to the nearest one within {{distance:5mi}}.

name: Locate Object
description: For up to 10 minutes, sense the direction of a familiar object within {{distance:1000ft}}, including its movement. Thick barriers of lead block the effect.

name: Magic Mouth
material: jade dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Place a spoken message of up to 25 words in an object. It speaks when your chosen observable trigger occurs, lasting until dispelled; casting consumes jade dust worth at least 10 GP.

name: Magic Weapon
description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes magical and gains +1 to attack and damage rolls for 1 hour. A level 3-5 slot makes the bonus +2; a level 6+ slot makes it +3.
higherLevels: The bonus becomes +2 with a level 3-5 slot and +3 with a level 6+ slot.

name: Mind Spike
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 Psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure you know its location on the same plane for up to 1 hour.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates appear for 1 minute. When an attack hits you, roll for remaining duplicates; a successful duplicate roll makes one of them take the hit instead.

name: Misty Step
description: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to {{distance:30ft}} to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Moonbeam
description: A {{distance:5ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:40ft|adj}}-high beam lasts up to 1 minute and can be moved {{distance:60ft}} with a Magic action. Creatures entering or ending a turn in it make Constitution saves against 2d10 Radiant damage, half on success; a failed save also ends shape-shifting.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d10 damage.

name: Pass without Trace
description: For up to 1 hour, chosen creatures within your {{distance:30ft|adj}} aura gain +10 to Stealth checks and leave no tracks.

name: Phantasmal Force
description: A creature failing an Intelligence save perceives a private illusion up to a {{distance:10ft|adj}} Cube for up to 1 minute. It can use a Study action to disbelieve; a dangerous phantasm can deal 2d8 Psychic damage to it on each of your turns.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: After a 10-minute casting, up to five creatures within range gain the benefits of a Short Rest and regain 2d8 Hit Points. Each can benefit only once per Long Rest; higher slots add 1d8 healing.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 healing.

name: Protection from Poison
description: End the Poisoned condition on a touched creature. For 1 hour it resists Poison damage and has Advantage on saves against becoming or remaining Poisoned.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: A creature makes a Constitution save. On success, its next attack roll has Disadvantage until your next turn. On failure, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 1d8 from damage rolls for up to 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

name: Rope Trick
description: Touch a rope to open an invisible extradimensional space at its upper end for 1 hour. Up to eight Medium or smaller creatures can hide inside.

name: Scorching Ray
description: Fire three rays, each requiring a ranged spell attack and dealing 2d6 Fire damage on a hit. Higher slots create one additional ray per level.
higherLevels: Create one additional ray for each slot level above 2.

name: See Invisibility
description: For 1 hour, see Invisible creatures and objects normally and perceive the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shatter
description: Creatures in a {{distance:10ft|adj}}-radius Sphere make Constitution saves, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on failure or half on success; Constructs save with Disadvantage. Higher slots add 1d8.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Shining Smite
castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: Immediately after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, deal an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. For up to 1 minute the target glows, cannot benefit from Invisibility, and attacks against it have Advantage.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.

name: Silence
description: Create a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere where no sound passes for up to 10 minutes. Creatures wholly inside are Deafened, immune to Thunder damage, and cannot cast spells with Verbal components.

name: Spider Climb
material: a drop of bitumen and a spider
description: A willing creature you touch gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed and can cross walls and ceilings hands-free for up to 1 hour. Higher slots add targets.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 allows one additional target.

name: Spike Growth
description: A {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius area becomes camouflaged Difficult Terrain for up to 10 minutes. A creature moving through it takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every {{distance:5ft}} traveled.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: Create a floating force weapon for up to 1 minute. Make a melee spell attack when it appears and on later turns with a Bonus Action; a hit deals 1d8 Force damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

name: Suggestion
description: A creature that hears and understands a plausible, nonharmful suggestion of up to 25 words makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Charmed and follows the activity for up to 8 hours, ending early if harmed or after completing it.

name: Warding Bond
material: a pair of platinum rings worth 50+ GP each, which you and the target must wear for the duration
description: Link yourself to a willing creature wearing one of the required platinum rings. While within {{distance:60ft}}, it gains +1 AC and saves and resistance to all damage, but you take the same damage it takes.

name: Web
description: Sticky webs fill a {{distance:20ft|adj}} Cube for up to 1 hour, making Difficult Terrain and light obscurity. A creature entering or starting there makes a Dexterity save or becomes Restrained; it can escape with a Strength (Athletics) action. Burning webs deal 2d4 Fire damage.

name: Zone of Truth
description: Create a {{distance:15ft|adj}}-radius Sphere for 10 minutes. Creatures entering or starting there make Charisma saves; those that fail cannot deliberately lie, and you know whether each creature saved.

name: Animate Dead
material: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust
description: Animate a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse as a Zombie or bones as a Skeleton. Command your undead within {{distance:60ft}} as a Bonus Action; control lasts 24 hours and can be renewed before it expires.
higherLevels: A slot above level 3 animates or reasserts control over two additional undead per extra slot level.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: Choose any number of creatures within {{distance:30ft}}. For up to 1 minute, they have Advantage on Wisdom and Death Saving Throws and regain the maximum possible Hit Points whenever healed.

name: Bestow Curse
description: A creature you touch makes a Wisdom save. On failure, choose one curse: Disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability; Disadvantage on attacks against you; a Wisdom save each turn or it must Dodge; or 1d8 extra Necrotic damage when you damage it with an attack or spell.
higherLevels: A level 4 slot extends concentration to 10 minutes; level 5-6 removes concentration and lasts 8 hours, level 7-8 lasts 24 hours, and level 9 lasts until dispelled.

name: Blink
description: For 1 minute, roll 1d6 at the end of each turn. On a 4-6 you shift to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to a free space within {{distance:10ft}} of where you left.

name: Call Lightning
description: Create a storm cloud overhead. When cast and as a Magic action on later turns, call lightning onto a point below it; creatures within {{distance:5ft}} make a Dexterity save against 3d10 Lightning damage, half on success. An existing storm adds 1d10.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Clairvoyance
material: a focus worth 100+ GP, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing
description: Place an invisible, stationary sensory point in a familiar or obvious location within {{distance:1mi}}. See or hear from it for up to 10 minutes; switch senses as a Bonus Action.

name: Conjure Animals
description: Summon an intangible Large pack of animal spirits for up to 10 minutes. It can move {{distance:30ft}} with you, grants Advantage on Strength saves while within {{distance:5ft}}, and can force creatures within {{distance:10ft}} to make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Slashing damage, once per turn.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3.

name: Counterspell
castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components
description: React when you see a creature within {{distance:60ft}} casting a spell with components. The caster makes a Constitution save; on failure its spell has no effect and the casting action is lost, but its spell slot is not spent.

name: Create Food and Water
description: Create 45 pounds of nourishing food and 30 gallons of clean water within {{distance:30ft}}. The food spoils after 24 hours.

name: Daylight
description: Fill a {{distance:60ft|adj}}-radius Sphere with sunlight and an additional {{distance:60ft}} of Dim Light for 1 hour, or center it on an unattended object. Overlapping magical Darkness from a level 3 or lower spell is dispelled.

name: Dispel Magic
description: End every level 3 or lower spell on a creature, object, or magical effect within {{distance:120ft}}. For each higher-level spell, make a spellcasting ability check against DC 10 plus its level.
higherLevels: Using a higher slot automatically ends spells on the target of a level no higher than that slot.

name: Fear
description: Creatures in a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Cone make a Wisdom save or drop held items and become Frightened for up to 1 minute. They must Dash away while able; they can repeat the save at the end of a turn without line of sight to you.

name: Fireball
material: a ball of bat guano and sulfur
description: A point within {{distance:150ft}} erupts in a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere. Creatures make a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Fire damage on failure or half on success. Unattended flammable objects ignite.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Fly
description: A willing creature you touch gains a Fly Speed of {{distance:60ft}} and can hover for up to 10 minutes. It falls when the spell ends unless it can prevent the fall.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 3.

name: Gaseous Form
description: A willing touched creature becomes mist for up to 1 hour. It flies at {{distance:10ft}}, can pass through narrow openings, resists Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing, and cannot attack, cast spells, speak, or manipulate objects.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 3.

name: Glyph of Warding
material: powdered diamond worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Inscribe a hidden glyph on a surface or closable object. A chosen trigger either explodes for 5d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage in a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere (Dexterity save for half) or releases a stored spell. Moving it more than {{distance:10ft}} breaks it.
higherLevels: Explosive damage rises by 1d8 per slot level above 3; a stored spell may be as high as the slot level used for the glyph.

name: Haste
description: A willing creature gains doubled Speed, +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves, and one extra limited action each turn for up to 1 minute. When it ends, the target is Incapacitated with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: Creatures that see a pattern in a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Cube make Wisdom saves or become Charmed, Incapacitated, and unable to move for up to 1 minute. Damage or another creature's action to shake a target ends its effect.

name: Lightning Bolt
material: a bit of fur and a crystal rod
description: A {{distance:100ft|adj}}-long, {{distance:5ft|adj}}-wide Line of lightning erupts from you. Creatures in it make Dexterity saves, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on failure or half on success.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Magic Circle
material: salt and powdered silver worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Create a {{distance:10ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:20ft|adj}}-tall cylinder for 1 hour. Selected Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead cannot normally enter, have Disadvantage on attacks into it, and cannot charm, frighten, or possess creatures inside. The barrier can instead trap them.
higherLevels: Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3.

name: Major Image
description: Create a convincing sight, sound, smell, and temperature of something no larger than a {{distance:20ft|adj}} Cube for up to 10 minutes. It cannot inflict damage or conditions; physical interaction reveals it. A Magic action can move and alter it.
higherLevels: With a level 4+ slot, the illusion lasts until dispelled and requires no concentration.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: As a Bonus Action, up to six visible creatures within {{distance:60ft}} each regain 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points.
higherLevels: Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3.

name: Meld into Stone
description: Merge yourself and your equipment into a large enough stone object for up to 8 hours. You can leave with {{distance:5ft}} of movement; damage or destruction of the stone may eject and harm you.

name: Nondetection
material: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: For 8 hours, a willing creature, place, or object no larger than {{distance:10ft}} cannot be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Phantom Steed
description: Create a quasi-real riding horse for 1 hour. It has a Speed of {{distance:100ft}} and can cover {{distance:13mi}} in an hour; it fades over 1 minute when the spell ends and vanishes early if damaged.

name: Plant Growth
description: Choose Overgrowth to make normal plants in a {{distance:100ft|adj}}-radius Sphere require {{distance:4ft}} of movement for every {{distance:1ft}} traveled, excluding areas you choose. Alternatively, spend 8 hours enriching plants in a {{distance:0.5mi|adj}} radius for double harvest over 365 days.

name: Protection from Energy
description: A willing touched creature has Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) for up to 1 hour.

name: Remove Curse
description: End all curses affecting a touched creature or object. On a cursed magic item, break the owner's Attunement so the item can be removed, but the item's curse remains.

name: Revivify
material: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Touch a creature that died within the last minute. It returns with 1 Hit Point. It cannot restore missing body parts or revive one that died of old age.

name: Sending
description: Send up to 25 words to a creature you have met or that has been described by someone who met it. It may answer immediately. Other planes have a 5% delivery failure chance; the recipient can block you for 8 hours.

name: Sleet Storm
description: A {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:40ft|adj}}-high Cylinder becomes heavily obscured and Difficult Terrain for up to 1 minute. Creatures entering or starting there make a Dexterity save or fall Prone and lose Concentration.

name: Slow
description: Up to six creatures in a {{distance:40ft|adj}} Cube make Wisdom saves. Failed targets have half Speed, -2 AC and Dexterity saves, no Reactions, one attack at most, and either an action or Bonus Action each turn; Somatic spells have a 25% failure chance. Repeat the save each turn.

name: Speak with Dead
description: Ask a corpse with a mouth up to five questions in 10 minutes. It knows only what it knew in life and need not answer truthfully; a corpse targeted within the past 10 days cannot be questioned again.

name: Speak with Plants
description: Plants in a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Emanation can report on the past day and follow simple commands for 10 minutes. You can turn plant-covered ground into or out of Difficult Terrain and communicate with Plant creatures.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Spirits fill a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Emanation around you for up to 10 minutes. Choose creatures to spare. Others have half Speed there and make a Wisdom save when the Emanation enters their space or they enter or end a turn in it; 3d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage on failure, half on success, once per turn.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.

name: Stinking Cloud
description: Create a heavily obscured, {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius gas Sphere for up to 1 minute. A creature starting its turn there makes a Constitution save or becomes Poisoned and cannot take an action or Bonus Action that turn. Strong wind disperses the cloud.

name: Tiny Hut
description: Create a stationary {{distance:10ft|adj}} Emanation shelter for 8 hours. Creatures and objects present when cast can pass through; others cannot. Level 3 or lower spells cannot pass through it. It ends if you leave or cast it again.

name: Tongues
description: A touched creature understands any spoken or signed language for 1 hour. Any creature that knows a language can understand the target's speech or signing.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack for 3d6 Necrotic damage on a hit and regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt. Repeat the attack as a Magic action each turn for up to 1 minute.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3.

name: Water Breathing
description: Up to ten willing creatures within {{distance:30ft}} can breathe underwater for 24 hours while retaining their usual breathing.

name: Water Walk
description: Up to ten willing creatures within {{distance:30ft}} can traverse liquid surfaces as solid ground for 1 hour. They may use a Bonus Action to move between the surface and the liquid beneath.

name: Wind Wall
description: Create a wind wall up to {{distance:50ft}} long, {{distance:15ft}} high, and {{distance:1ft}} thick for up to 1 minute. Creatures in its space make a Strength save against 4d8 Bludgeoning damage, half on success. It blocks gases, small flying creatures, and ordinary projectiles.

name: Arcane Eye
description: Create an invisible, invulnerable hovering eye for up to 1 hour. See through it in every direction, including with {{distance:30ft|adj}} Darkvision; move it {{distance:30ft}} as a Bonus Action, even through openings at least {{distance:1in}} wide.

name: Aura of Life
description: For up to 10 minutes, a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Emanation around you grants you and your allies Resistance to Necrotic damage and prevents Hit Point maximum reduction. An ally starting a turn there at 0 Hit Points regains 1 Hit Point.

name: Banishment
description: A visible creature makes a Charisma save or is sent to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated, for up to 1 minute. It returns when the spell ends, except an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend remains away if the full minute passes.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Black Tentacles
description: A {{distance:20ft|adj}}-square area becomes Difficult Terrain for up to 1 minute. Creatures there make Strength saves or take 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and become Restrained; the save repeats on entering or ending a turn there, once per turn. A Restrained target can escape with an Athletics action.

name: Blight
description: A visible creature within {{distance:30ft}} makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on failure or half on success. Plants automatically fail; an unattended nonmagical plant instead withers and dies.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Charm Monster
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save, with Advantage if you or an ally is fighting it. On failure it is Charmed and Friendly for 1 hour, ending early if harmed by you or an ally; afterward it knows you charmed it.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Compulsion
description: Chosen visible creatures within {{distance:30ft}} make Wisdom saves or become Charmed for up to 1 minute. As a Bonus Action, designate a horizontal direction; affected creatures move that way by the safest route on their next turns, then repeat the save.

name: Confusion
description: Creatures in a {{distance:10ft|adj}}-radius Sphere make Wisdom saves. Failed targets cannot use Bonus Actions or Reactions and roll 1d10 each turn to determine whether they move randomly, do nothing, attack a random nearby creature, or act normally. They repeat the save each turn.
higherLevels: The Sphere radius increases by {{distance:5ft}} per slot level above 4.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: For up to 10 minutes, spirits fill a {{distance:15ft|adj}} Emanation around you. Enemies treat the ground there as Difficult Terrain, and your attacks that hit a creature in it deal an extra 2d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.
higherLevels: Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
description: Nature spirits fill a {{distance:10ft|adj}} Emanation around you for up to 10 minutes. Creatures entering or ending a turn there, or entered by the Emanation, can be forced to make a Wisdom save against 5d8 Force damage, half on success, once per turn. You may Disengage as a Bonus Action.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Control Water
material: a mixture of water and dust
description: Control water in a Cube up to {{distance:100ft}} on a side for up to 10 minutes. Flood raises the water or sends a wave, Part Water opens a passage, Redirect Flow changes its course, and Whirlpool drags creatures toward the center and can deal 2d8 Bludgeoning damage.

name: Death Ward
description: For 8 hours, the first time a touched creature would drop to 0 Hit Points, it drops to 1 instead. If an effect would kill it instantly without damage, that effect is negated instead. The spell then ends.

name: Dimension Door
description: Teleport yourself to a specified point within {{distance:500ft}}, optionally bringing one willing creature within {{distance:5ft}}. If the destination is occupied or full, teleportation fails and each traveler takes 4d6 Force damage.

name: Divination
material: incense worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Ask a deity or its servants one question about an event or goal within the next 7 days and receive a truthful, possibly cryptic answer. Each extra casting before a Long Rest has a cumulative 25% chance of giving no answer.

name: Dominate Beast
description: A visible Beast makes a Wisdom save or becomes Charmed for up to 1 minute. You can command it telepathically without an action; it repeats the save whenever damaged. It has Advantage on the initial save if you are fighting it.
higherLevels: A level 5 slot extends concentration to 10 minutes, level 6 to 1 hour, and level 7+ to 8 hours.

name: Fabricate
description: Transform raw materials into a Large or smaller object, or a Medium or smaller one of metal, stone, or another mineral. You need appropriate Artisan's Tool proficiency for finely crafted items such as weapons or armor; it cannot create creatures or magic items.

name: Faithful Hound
description: Conjure an invisible, invulnerable watchdog for 8 hours. It barks when an unapproved creature comes within {{distance:30ft}}, has {{distance:30ft|adj}} Truesight, and at the start of each of your turns bites one enemy within {{distance:5ft}} for 4d8 Force damage on a failed Dexterity save.

name: Fire Shield
material: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly
description: A warm or chill shield surrounds you for 10 minutes. Warm grants Resistance to Cold and retaliates for 2d8 Fire damage when a nearby creature hits you in melee; chill grants Resistance to Fire and retaliates for 2d8 Cold.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: A willing touched creature ignores Difficult Terrain and magical effects that reduce Speed or cause Paralyzed or Restrained for 1 hour. It gains a Swim Speed equal to its Speed and can spend {{distance:5ft}} of movement to escape nonmagical restraints.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 4.

name: Giant Insect
description: Summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp in a space within {{distance:60ft}} for up to 10 minutes. It acts immediately after your turn, obeys verbal commands, and uses the Giant Insect stat block; the form changes its abilities.
higherLevels: Use the slot level for the summoned insect's spell level and scaling statistics.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition for up to 1 minute, including while attacking or casting.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: Summon an invulnerable Large guardian for up to 8 hours. Enemies entering or starting a turn within {{distance:10ft}} make a Dexterity save, taking 20 Radiant damage on failure or half on success. It vanishes after dealing 60 total damage.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
description: Make a {{distance:150ft|adj}} Cube of natural terrain appear, sound, and smell like different natural terrain for 24 hours. Structures, equipment, and creatures remain unchanged; touch or a successful Investigation check can reveal the illusion.

name: Ice Storm
description: Hail strikes a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:40ft|adj}}-high Cylinder. Creatures make Dexterity saves against 2d10 Bludgeoning plus 4d6 Cold damage, half on success. The ground becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
higherLevels: Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Locate Creature
description: For up to 1 hour, sense the direction of a familiar named creature within {{distance:1000ft}}, or the nearest creature of a kind you have seen up close. A changed form or a lead barrier blocks it.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save against its worst fear. On failure it takes 4d10 Psychic damage and has Disadvantage on checks and attacks; on success it takes half and the spell ends. It repeats the save each turn, taking 4d10 again on failure.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4.

name: Polymorph
description: A creature you see makes a Wisdom save or becomes a Beast with CR no higher than its CR or level for up to 1 hour. It uses the Beast's statistics but keeps its Hit Points and Hit Dice and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's Hit Points; the spell ends when those Temporary Hit Points run out.

name: Private Sanctum
description: Ward a Cube from {{distance:5ft|num}} to {{distance:100ft}} per side for 24 hours. Choose barriers against sound or sight, Divination sensors and targeting, teleportation, or planar travel. Casting daily in the same place for 365 days makes it permanent.
higherLevels: Maximum Cube size increases by {{distance:100ft}} per slot level above 4.

name: Resilient Sphere
description: Enclose a Large or smaller creature or object in an invulnerable sphere for up to 1 minute; an unwilling creature makes a Dexterity save. Nothing can pass through it, though those inside can breathe; the sphere can be rolled or moved.

name: Secret Chest
material: a chest, {{distance:3ft}} by {{distance:2ft}} by {{distance:2ft}}, constructed from rare materials worth 5,000+ GP, and a Tiny replica of the chest made from the same materials worth 50+ GP
description: Hide a specially made {{distance:3ft|num}}-by-{{distance:2ft|num}}-by-{{distance:2ft|adj}} chest and up to 12 cubic feet of contents on the Ethereal Plane. Touch its tiny replica with a Magic action to recall or return it. After 60 days, each day has a cumulative 5% chance of ending the spell.

name: Stone Shape
description: Reshape a Medium or smaller stone object, or a section of stone no more than {{distance:5ft}} across, into a form you choose. It can make a simple opening, door, or container but not fine machinery.

name: Stoneskin
material: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: A willing touched creature has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for up to 1 hour.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
description: A {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere of acid erupts within {{distance:150ft}}. Creatures make Dexterity saves; failure deals 10d4 Acid damage immediately and 5d4 at the end of their next turn, while success halves only the initial damage.
higherLevels: Initial damage increases by 2d4 per slot level above 4.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Create a fire wall up to {{distance:60ft}} long and {{distance:20ft}} high, or a ring up to {{distance:20ft}} across, for up to 1 minute. Creatures in its space make Dexterity saves against 5d8 Fire damage, half on success. One chosen side also deals 5d8 to creatures entering the wall or ending within {{distance:10ft}}.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4.

name: Animate Objects
description: Animate unattended nonmagical objects up to your spellcasting ability modifier; Medium or smaller count as one, Large as two, Huge as three. Each becomes an allied Construct (AC 15; HP 10/20/40 by size), acts after you, and obeys your Bonus Action commands within {{distance:500ft}}. Its melee Slam uses your spell attack bonus and deals 1d4+3 Force (Medium or smaller), 2d6+3+your spellcasting modifier (Large), or 2d12+3+your modifier (Huge).
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 1d4 Slam damage for Medium or smaller objects, 1d6 for Large, or 1d12 for Huge.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A {{distance:10ft|adj}} Emanation around you prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it for up to 1 hour. Those creatures can still cast spells or attack through it with ranged or Reach weapons. Forcing one through the barrier ends the spell.

name: Arcane Hand
description: Create a Large magical hand (AC 20, Hit Points equal to yours) for up to 1 minute. Move it up to {{distance:60ft}} on casting and as a Bonus Action later, then choose an effect: a melee spell attack for 5d8 Force, push, grapple and crush for 4d6 plus your spellcasting modifier, or grant Half Cover.
higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 2d8 to Clenched Fist and 2d6 to Grasping Hand damage.

name: Awaken
material: an agate worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: After 8 hours, give a Beast or Plant creature with Intelligence 3 or less, or a natural plant, Intelligence 10 and one language you know. A natural plant becomes a mobile Plant creature. The target is Charmed by you for 30 days or until harmed by you or an ally.

name: Cloudkill
description: Create a heavily obscured {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius fog Sphere for up to 10 minutes; it moves {{distance:10ft}} away from you each turn. Creatures there make Constitution saves against 5d8 Poison damage, half on success, when it appears, moves over them, or they enter or end a turn there, once per turn.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Commune
description: Ask a deity or proxy up to three yes-or-no questions within 1 minute and receive truthful answers, possibly 'unclear'. Extra castings before a Long Rest each add a cumulative 25% chance of no answer.

name: Commune with Nature
description: Learn three facts about the surrounding natural area: settlements, planar portals, a significant otherworldly creature, predominant plants/minerals/Beasts, or bodies of water. Radius is {{distance:3mi}} outdoors or {{distance:300ft}} underground; it fails in constructed areas.

name: Cone of Cold
material: a small crystal or glass cone
description: A {{distance:60ft|adj}} Cone of cold forces Constitution saves. Creatures take 8d8 Cold damage on failure or half on success; creatures killed by it freeze until thawed.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: Conjure a Large intangible spirit for up to 10 minutes. Choose air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire), or water (Cold). It can restrain a creature near or inside it after a Dexterity save; failure deals 8d8 damage, then 4d8 on subsequent failed saves while restrained.
higherLevels: The initial damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: Make a DC 15 Intelligence save to contact an extraplanar intelligence. On success, ask up to five questions within 1 minute; answers are brief. On failure, take 6d6 Psychic damage and become Incapacitated until a Long Rest or Greater Restoration.

name: Contagion
description: A touched creature makes a Constitution save. Failure deals 11d8 Necrotic damage and inflicts Poisoned with Disadvantage on saves using one chosen ability. It repeats the save each turn until three successes end the spell or three failures make it last 7 days.

name: Creation
description: Make an object up to a {{distance:5ft|adj}} Cube from shadow matter you have seen. Vegetable material lasts 24 hours, stone or crystal 12 hours, precious metal 1 hour, gems 10 minutes, or adamantine/mithral 1 minute. The object cannot serve as another spell's material component.
higherLevels: The maximum Cube increases by {{distance:5ft}} per slot level above 5.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
description: For up to 1 minute, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attacks against you. End the spell to free a touched creature from their possession, charm, or fear, or force one within {{distance:5ft}} to make a Charisma save or return to its home plane.

name: Dominate Person
description: A visible Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed for up to 1 minute. Command it through a telepathic link without an action; it repeats the save when damaged. It has Advantage on the initial save if you are fighting it.
higherLevels: Concentration can last 10 minutes with a level 6 slot, 1 hour with level 7, or 8 hours with level 8+.

name: Dream
description: A willing messenger enters the dreams of a known creature on the same plane, speaking with it while it sleeps. A terrifying version delivers up to ten words; the target makes a Wisdom save or gains no benefit from its rest and takes 3d6 Psychic damage on waking.

name: Flame Strike
description: A {{distance:10ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:40ft|adj}}-high Cylinder forces Dexterity saves. Creatures take 5d6 Fire plus 5d6 Radiant damage on failure, or half of each on success.
higherLevels: Both Fire and Radiant damage increase by 1d6 per slot level above 5.

name: Geas
description: A creature that understands your command makes a Wisdom save or becomes Charmed for 30 days. Acting directly against the command deals 5d10 Psychic damage, at most once per day. Suicidal commands end the spell.
higherLevels: A level 7 or 8 slot lasts 365 days; a level 9 slot lasts until ended by Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish.

name: Greater Restoration
material: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Touch a creature to remove one Exhaustion level, Charmed or Petrified, a curse or cursed-item Attunement, an ability-score reduction, or a reduction of its maximum Hit Points.

name: Hallow
material: incense worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Ward an area up to {{distance:60ft}} in radius until dispelled. Selected Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead cannot willingly enter, and their possession, charm, or fear is suppressed there. Choose an extra effect such as light, darkness, silence, resistance, vulnerability, courage, fear, tongues, or blocking teleportation.

name: Hold Monster
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save or becomes Paralyzed for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.
higherLevels: Target one additional creature per slot level above 5.

name: Insect Plague
description: Locusts fill a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius Sphere for up to 10 minutes, making it lightly obscured and Difficult Terrain. Creatures make Constitution saves against 4d10 Piercing damage, half on success, when it appears or they enter or end a turn there, once per turn.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

name: Legend Lore
material: incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each
description: Recall a truthful, possibly figurative summary of important lore about a famous person, place, or object. Knowing more about the subject yields more detail; the spell fails if it is not famous.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Choose up to six creatures in a {{distance:30ft|adj}}-radius Sphere around a visible point within {{distance:60ft}}. Each regains 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points.
higherLevels: Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5.

name: Mislead
description: Become Invisible and create an illusory double at your location for up to 1 hour. Your invisibility ends when you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell. Move the intangible double with a Magic action and see and hear through it.

name: Modify Memory
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save (with Advantage if fighting you) or becomes Charmed and Incapacitated. Describe a changed memory of an event from the past 24 hours lasting at most 10 minutes; damage or another spell ends this without altering memory.
higherLevels: A level 6 slot reaches 7 days into the past, level 7 reaches 30 days, level 8 reaches 365 days, and level 9 reaches any time.

name: Passwall
description: Open a passage through wood, plaster, or stone within {{distance:30ft}}, up to {{distance:5ft}} wide, {{distance:8ft}} tall, and {{distance:20ft}} deep, for 1 hour. When it closes, occupants are safely ejected.

name: Planar Binding
material: a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend that stays within {{distance:60ft}} for the 1-hour casting. It makes a Charisma save or serves you for 24 hours; a summoning spell's duration extends to match the binding.
higherLevels: Duration becomes 10 days with a level 6 slot, 30 days with level 7, 180 days with level 8, or 366 days with level 9.

name: Raise Dead
material: a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Revive a creature dead no longer than 10 days, except one that died as Undead. It returns with 1 Hit Point and a -4 penalty to D20 Tests, reduced by 1 after each Long Rest. Missing vital body parts make the spell fail.

name: Reincarnate
material: rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Revive a Humanoid dead no longer than 10 days in a newly formed body. Determine a new playable species by the spell's table or GM choice; the creature keeps its memories and other capabilities but replaces its former species traits.

name: Scrying
material: a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font
description: See and hear a creature on your plane for up to 10 minutes through a moving invisible sensor if it fails a Wisdom save. The save modifier is +5 if known secondhand, +0 if met, or -5 if known well, then -2 for a likeness, -4 for a possession, or -10 for a body part. On success it cannot be targeted by your Scrying for 24 hours. You can instead place a stationary sensor at a location you have seen.

name: Seeming
description: Give each chosen creature you see within {{distance:30ft}} an illusory appearance for 8 hours. Unwilling targets may make Charisma saves. Physical inspection or a successful Investigation check against your spell save DC reveals the disguise.

name: Summon Dragon
material: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP
description: Summon a Draconic Spirit for up to 1 hour. It has AC 14 plus slot level, HP 50 plus 10 per slot level above 5, Fly {{distance:60ft}}, and acts immediately after you. It makes floor(slot level / 2) Rend attacks using your spell attack bonus; each hit deals 1d6+4+slot level Piercing damage. Its {{distance:30ft|adj}} Cone breath deals 2d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage (Dexterity save for half). Choose one of its resistances to share for the duration.
higherLevels: Use the slot level to determine the spirit's AC, Hit Points, and other scaling statistics.

name: Telekinesis
description: For up to 10 minutes, use a Magic action each turn to move or manipulate a Huge or smaller creature or object within {{distance:60ft}}. A creature makes a Strength save or is moved up to {{distance:30ft}} and Restrained until the end of your next turn.

name: Telepathic Bond
description: Link up to eight willing creatures within {{distance:30ft}} for 1 hour. They communicate telepathically across any distance on the same plane, regardless of shared languages.

name: Teleportation Circle
material: rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Draw a temporary {{distance:5ft|adj}}-radius portal leading to a permanent circle on the same plane whose sigils you know. It stays open until the end of your next turn. Casting it in the same place daily for 365 days creates a permanent circle.

name: Tree Stride
description: For up to 1 minute, enter a living tree and emerge from another living tree of the same kind within {{distance:500ft}}, spending {{distance:5ft}} of movement to enter and another {{distance:5ft|num}} to emerge. Use this travel once per turn and end each turn outside a tree.

name: Wall of Force
description: Create an invisible, invulnerable wall of ten contiguous {{distance:10ft|adj}} panels or a dome/globe of up to {{distance:10ft|adj}} radius for up to 10 minutes. Nothing physical crosses it; Dispel Magic cannot end it, but Disintegrate destroys it.

name: Wall of Stone
description: Create ten contiguous stone panels, each {{distance:10ft}} square and {{distance:6in}} thick, or {{distance:10ft|num}}-by-{{distance:20ft|adj}} panels {{distance:3in}} thick. A surrounded creature can make a Dexterity save to move away. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points per inch; concentrating for all 10 minutes makes the wall permanent.

name: Blade Barrier
description: Create a wall of magical blades up to {{distance:100ft}} long and {{distance:20ft}} high, or a {{distance:60ft|adj}}-diameter ring, for up to 10 minutes. Its space is Difficult Terrain and grants Three-Quarters Cover. Creatures in it make Dexterity saves against 6d10 Force damage, half on success, when it appears or they enter or end a turn there, once per turn.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning strikes one visible target within {{distance:150ft}} and leaps to up to three others within {{distance:30ft}} of it. Each target makes a Dexterity save against 10d8 Lightning damage, half on success; no target is hit twice.
higherLevels: One additional bolt leaps to a new target per slot level above 6.

name: Circle of Death
material: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP
description: A {{distance:60ft|adj}}-radius Sphere of negative energy forces Constitution saves, dealing 8d8 Necrotic damage on failure or half on success.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 2d8 per slot level above 6.

name: Conjure Fey
description: Summon a Medium Fey spirit for up to 10 minutes. On appearance, make a melee spell attack from its space; a hit deals 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier Psychic damage and Frightens the target until your next turn. Later, a Bonus Action can teleport the spirit {{distance:30ft}} and repeat the attack.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 6.

name: Contingency
material: a gem-encrusted statuette of yourself worth 1,500+ GP
description: Cast this spell and a prepared level 5 or lower spell that takes an action and can target you, spending both slots. The second spell waits up to 10 days for your chosen trigger, then affects only you. Only one Contingency can be active; losing its required statuette ends it.

name: Create Undead
material: one 150+ GP black onyx stone for each corpse
description: Only at night, animate up to three Medium or Small Humanoid corpses as Ghouls, using a 150+ GP black onyx for each corpse. Command them within {{distance:120ft}} as a Bonus Action. Control lasts 24 hours and must be renewed before it expires.
higherLevels: A level 7 slot controls four Ghouls; level 8 controls five Ghouls or two Ghasts/Wights; level 9 controls six Ghouls, three Ghasts/Wights, or two Mummies.

name: Disintegrate
description: A visible creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d6 + 40 Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is disintegrated; a Large or smaller nonmagical object or magical-force creation is disintegrated automatically.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 3d6 per slot level above 6.

name: Eyebite
description: For up to 1 minute, force a visible creature within {{distance:60ft}} to make a Wisdom save, then choose Asleep (Unconscious), Panicked (Frightened and forced to flee), or Sickened (Poisoned). On later turns, a Magic action can target another creature that has not saved against this casting.

name: Find the Path
material: a set of divination tools-such as cards or runes-worth 100+ GP
description: For up to 1 day, sense the most direct physical route to a familiar, fixed location on your current plane. Know its direction and distance while traveling; the spell fails for vague or moving destinations.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: A visible creature makes a Constitution save. Failure Restrains it; success leaves its Speed 0 until your next turn. A Restrained target repeats saves each turn: three successes end the spell, three failures Petrify it. Concentrating for the full minute makes Petrified persist.

name: Forbiddance
description: Ward up to 40,000 square feet of floor and {{distance:30ft}} above it against teleportation and planar travel for 1 day. Chosen Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead take 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage on entering or ending a turn there unless they speak your password. Daily casting for 30 days makes it permanent and consumes the ruby dust on the last casting.

name: Freezing Sphere
description: A {{distance:60ft|adj}}-radius Sphere forces Constitution saves against 10d6 Cold damage, half on success. Water struck freezes and may Restrain surface swimmers. You can instead hold the globe for up to 1 minute, then throw it later before it explodes.
higherLevels: Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: An immobile {{distance:10ft|adj}} Emanation around you blocks spells of level 5 or lower cast from outside it from affecting anything inside for up to 1 minute.
higherLevels: The highest blocked spell level increases by 1 per slot level above 6.

name: Guards and Wards
description: Ward up to 2,500 square feet, {{distance:20ft}} high, for 24 hours. Choose exempt creatures and a password. Corridors fill with obscuring fog and can misdirect travelers; doors receive Arcane Lock, up to ten doors appear as walls, and stairs fill with regrowing Web. Also place Dancing Lights, Magic Mouth, Stinking Cloud, Gust of Wind, or Suggestion in specified locations. Casting daily for 365 days makes the ward permanent.

name: Harm
description: A visible creature makes a Constitution save. Failure deals 14d6 Necrotic damage and reduces its Hit Point maximum by the damage taken, but not below 1. Success deals half damage without reducing the maximum.

name: Heal
description: A visible creature within {{distance:60ft}} regains 70 Hit Points and loses the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions.
higherLevels: Healing increases by 10 Hit Points per slot level above 6.

name: Heroes' Feast
material: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Conjure a feast for up to twelve creatures to consume over 1 hour. For the next 24 hours, each diner has Resistance to Poison damage, immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, and gains 2d10 maximum and current Hit Points.

name: Instant Summons
description: Mark an object weighing up to 10 pounds and no longer than {{distance:6ft}} with a 1,000+ GP sapphire. Later, crush the sapphire as a Magic action to summon the object into your hand from any distance or plane. If another creature holds it, learn who and where they are instead.

name: Irresistible Dance
description: A visible creature makes a Wisdom save. Even on success it must spend all movement dancing until the end of its next turn. On failure it is also Charmed, has Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attacks, and grants Advantage to attacks against it; it can use an action to repeat the save.

name: Magic Jar
material: a gem, crystal, or reliquary worth 500+ GP
description: Place your soul in a 500+ GP container, leaving your body catatonic. From it, attempt to possess a visible Humanoid within {{distance:100ft}}; it makes a Charisma save. On failure, you control its body while its soul is trapped in the container. Losing your body or container at the wrong time can kill you or the host.

name: Mass Suggestion
description: Give a plausible, nonharmful course of action of at most 25 words to up to twelve creatures within {{distance:60ft}} that understand you. Each makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and pursues it for up to 24 hours, ending early when completed or if harmed by you or an ally.
higherLevels: Duration becomes 10 days with a level 7 slot, 30 days with level 8, or 366 days with level 9.

name: Move Earth
description: Reshape an area of dirt, sand, or clay up to {{distance:40ft}} on a side. Each change takes 10 minutes and can raise or lower terrain, dig or fill trenches, or build walls and pillars up to half the area's largest dimension. You may select a new area every 10 minutes for up to 2 hours.

name: Planar Ally
