description: Request a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend from an otherworldly power. It appears within {{distance:60ft}} but is not compelled to help; bargain for a service, generally costing about 100 GP per minute, 1,000 GP per hour, or 10,000 GP per day, subject to the GM.

name: Programmed Illusion
description: Create a hidden illusion no larger than a {{distance:30ft|adj}} Cube. A visual or audible trigger within {{distance:30ft}} activates a scripted sight and sound lasting up to 5 minutes. After a 10-minute dormancy, it can trigger again until dispelled.

name: Sunbeam
description: Send a {{distance:60ft|adj}}-long, {{distance:5ft|adj}}-wide Line of sunlight from yourself. Creatures make Constitution saves against 6d8 Radiant damage and Blinded until your next turn; success halves damage and avoids Blinded. A Magic action can fire another beam each turn for up to 1 minute.

name: Transport via Plants
description: Link a Large or larger inanimate plant within {{distance:10ft}} to a plant you have seen or touched on the same plane, at any distance. For 1 minute, creatures can spend {{distance:5ft}} of movement to enter the first and emerge from the second.

name: True Seeing
material: mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: A willing touched creature gains {{distance:120ft|adj}} Truesight for 1 hour.

name: Wall of Ice
description: Create a {{distance:1ft|adj}}-thick ice dome/globe of up to {{distance:10ft|adj}} radius or ten contiguous {{distance:10ft|adj}} panels for up to 10 minutes. A creature displaced by its appearance makes a Dexterity save against 10d6 Cold damage. Destroyed panels leave frigid air that deals 5d6 Cold damage on a failed Constitution save when crossed.
higherLevels: Appearance damage increases by 2d6 and frigid-air damage by 1d6 per slot level above 6.

name: Wall of Thorns
description: Create a thorn wall up to {{distance:60ft}} long and {{distance:10ft}} high, or a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-diameter ring, for up to 10 minutes. Creatures in its space make Dexterity saves against 7d8 Piercing damage when it appears. Moving through costs {{distance:4ft}} for every {{distance:1ft}}; entering or ending a turn there deals 7d8 Slashing damage on a failed Dexterity save, once per turn.
higherLevels: Both damage types increase by 1d8 per slot level above 6.

name: Wind Walk
description: You and up to ten willing creatures become clouds for 8 hours, gaining {{distance:300ft|adj}} Fly Speed, hover, immunity to Prone, and resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing. Cloud form permits only Dash or beginning a 1-minute return to normal form, during which the creature is Stunned.

name: Word of Recall
description: Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures within {{distance:5ft}} to the sanctuary you previously designated by casting this spell there. Without a prepared sanctuary, the spell has no effect.

name: Arcane Sword
description: Create a floating sword of force for up to 1 minute. Make a melee spell attack against a target within {{distance:5ft}} of it; on a hit it deals 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier Force damage. As a Bonus Action on later turns, move the sword up to {{distance:30ft}} and attack again.

name: Conjure Celestial
description: A celestial presence fills a {{distance:10ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:40ft|adj}}-high cylinder for up to 10 minutes. Each visible creature in it can receive 4d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier healing or make a Dexterity save against 6d12 Radiant damage (half on success). When you move on your turn, the cylinder can move up to {{distance:30ft}}. Creatures entering or ending a turn there can be affected; each creature is affected only once per turn.
higherLevels: Healing increases by 1d12 and damage by 1d12 per slot level above 7.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
material: a ball of bat guano and sulfur
description: A glowing bead waits at a point within {{distance:150ft}} for up to 1 minute. When concentration ends, creatures in a {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius sphere make a Dexterity save against 12d6 Fire damage, half on success. The damage grows by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns while you concentrate. A creature can pick up or throw the bead with a Dexterity save; failure detonates it.
higherLevels: The initial damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7.

name: Divine Word
description: Choose creatures you can see within {{distance:30ft}}; each makes a Charisma save. A failing creature with 20 or fewer Hit Points dies; with 21-30 HP it is Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned for 1 hour; with 31-40 HP it is Blinded and Deafened for 10 minutes; with 41-50 HP it is Deafened for 1 minute. A Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend that fails is also banished to its home plane for at least 24 hours.

name: Etherealness
description: Enter the Border Ethereal for up to 8 hours. You can move through creatures and objects on the Material Plane, but cannot affect them. When the spell ends, you return to the nearest unoccupied space; this spell ends early if you dismiss it.
higherLevels: For each slot level above 7, you can bring three additional willing creatures within {{distance:10ft}}.

name: Finger of Death
description: One visible creature within {{distance:60ft}} makes a Constitution save against 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage, taking half on success. A Humanoid killed by this spell rises as a Zombie at the start of your next turn and follows your verbal commands.

name: Fire Storm
description: Create up to ten contiguous {{distance:10ft|adj}} cubes of flame within {{distance:150ft}}. Creatures there make a Dexterity save against 7d10 Fire damage, half on success. You can spare plants of your choice.

name: Forcecage
material: ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: For up to 1 hour of concentration, imprison creatures in a cage of force up to {{distance:20ft}} on a side or a solid box up to {{distance:10ft}} on a side. A trapped creature cannot leave by nonmagical means; teleportation or planar travel requires a successful Charisma save. Dispel Magic cannot end the cage.

name: Magnificent Mansion
description: Create an extradimensional dwelling for 24 hours, with a door within {{distance:300ft}}. It contains up to fifty {{distance:10ft|adj}} cubes, food for 100 guests, and up to 100 servants; only creatures you designate can enter.

name: Mirage Arcane
description: For 10 days, change the look, sound, smell, and tactile feel of terrain in an area up to {{distance:1mi}} square. You can add or alter structures and make terrain harder or easier to traverse, but cannot disguise or create creatures. Truesight reveals the original terrain without removing the illusion's physical effects.

name: Plane Shift
material: a forked, metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence
description: Transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures linked hand in hand to another plane with an attuned forked metal rod. Name a general destination and arrive in or near it as the GM decides, or travel to a teleportation circle on that plane whose sigil sequence you know.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: Creatures in a {{distance:60ft|adj}} cone make Dexterity saves; roll 1d8 separately for each target. Results 1-5 deal 12d6 Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison, or Cold damage (half on a successful save); 6 Restrains, with three failed Constitution saves causing Petrified; 7 Blinds and may banish after a Wisdom save; 8 strikes with two different rays.

name: Project Image
material: a statuette of yourself worth 5+ GP
description: Create an illusory copy of yourself up to {{distance:500mi}} away for up to 1 day of concentration. It looks and sounds like you, and you can see and hear through it and move it up to {{distance:60ft}} with a Magic action. Physical interaction or a successful Investigation check can reveal the illusion.

name: Regenerate
description: A creature you touch immediately regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points and then regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for 1 hour. Severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.

name: Resurrection
material: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Return a creature dead no more than 100 years to life with full Hit Points. It cannot have died of old age or have been Undead at death; poisons and missing body parts are restored. It takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests, reduced by 1 after each Long Rest. If it has been dead for at least 365 days, you cannot cast spells and have Disadvantage on D20 Tests until your next Long Rest.

name: Reverse Gravity
description: Reverse gravity in a {{distance:50ft|adj}}-radius, {{distance:100ft|adj}}-high cylinder for up to 1 minute. Creatures and objects fall upward, unless a creature succeeds on a Dexterity save to grab something fixed; they fall again when the spell ends.

name: Sequester
material: gem dust worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Make a willing creature or object Invisible and undetectable by magic until a condition you set ends the spell or the target takes damage. An affected creature is Unconscious, does not age, and needs no food, water, or air.

name: Simulacrum
material: powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: After 12 hours, create a Construct duplicate of a Beast or Humanoid from snow or ice. It has half the original's maximum Hit Points, cannot gain levels or regain spent abilities by resting, and cannot cast Simulacrum. Repairs during a Long Rest cost 100 GP of materials per Hit Point restored. You can have only one active simulacrum.

name: Symbol
material: powdered diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Inscribe a nearly invisible glyph with a trigger you define. When triggered, it affects creatures in a {{distance:60ft|adj}}-radius sphere for 10 minutes with one chosen effect: Death (Constitution save, 10d10 Necrotic, half on success), Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep, or Stunning, each with its own save and condition. A creature is affected at most once per turn.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures within {{distance:10ft}}, or one Large or smaller object, to a known location on the same plane. The GM rolls d100 based on your familiarity: a permanent circle or recent linked object always arrives on target; other destinations can cause a mishap (3d10 Force damage and reroll), similar area, or an off-target arrival.

name: Animal Shapes
description: Any number of willing creatures you can see within {{distance:30ft}} become Large or smaller Beasts of CR 4 or less for 24 hours. Each retains its Hit Points, Hit Dice, mental ability scores, communication, and creature type, but cannot cast spells or use merged equipment. Each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the first form's Hit Points. You can change their forms again with a Magic action; a target can end its form with a Bonus Action.

name: Antimagic Field
description: A {{distance:10ft|adj}} emanation centered on you suppresses spells and other magical effects for up to 1 hour of concentration. It prevents spellcasting and magical travel into or within the area, suppresses magic items, and blocks most magical areas and summoned creatures, but not magic from artifacts or deities.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
material: a mix of vinegar and honey
description: For 10 days, make a creature or an object repel or attract one kind of creature you specify. A creature of that kind within {{distance:120ft}} makes a Wisdom save: Antipathy makes it Frightened and drives it away, while Sympathy Charms it and draws it closer. Repeated saves can end the effect for a creature.

name: Befuddlement
material: a key ring with no keys
description: One creature within {{distance:150ft}} makes an Intelligence save against 10d12 Psychic damage, half on success. On a failed save it also cannot cast spells or take the Magic action. It repeats the save every 30 days; Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish can end the effect.

name: Clone
material: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP that is large enough to hold the creature being cloned
description: Grow an inert duplicate of a living creature from a piece of its flesh. After 120 days, if the original dies and its soul is willing and free, it enters the clone, which can be younger. Requires a 1,000 GP diamond consumed by the spell and a sealable vessel worth at least 2,000 GP.

name: Control Weather
description: For up to 8 hours of concentration outdoors, control the weather within {{distance:5mi}}. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind one stage at a time; each adjustment takes 1d4 x 10 minutes to take effect.

name: Demiplane
description: Open a shadowy door to a {{distance:30ft|adj}} cubic extradimensional room for 1 hour. You can connect it to a new demiplane, one you created before, or another demiplane you know the nature and contents of.

name: Dominate Monster
description: One creature within {{distance:60ft}} makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and telepathically controlled for up to 1 hour of concentration. You can issue commands and take direct control; damage to it allows another save to end the spell.
higherLevels: With a level 9 slot, concentration can last up to 8 hours.

name: Earthquake
description: For up to 1 minute, tremors make the ground in a {{distance:100ft|adj}}-radius circle Difficult Terrain. Creatures there make Dexterity saves when cast and each turn or fall Prone and lose concentration. The spell opens 1d6 fissures and deals 50 Bludgeoning damage to structures each turn; a collapsing structure can deal 12d6 Bludgeoning damage (Dexterity save for half).

name: Glibness
description: For 1 hour, treat any Charisma check roll of 14 or less as 15. Magic that tests whether you speak truth treats what you say as truthful.

name: Holy Aura
description: For up to 1 minute, chosen creatures in a {{distance:30ft|adj}} emanation around you have Advantage on all saving throws, while other creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against them. A Fiend or Undead that hits a protected creature in melee must make a Constitution save or be Blinded.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: A heavily obscured {{distance:20ft|adj}}-radius sphere of smoke appears within {{distance:150ft}} and moves {{distance:10ft}} away from you each turn. Creatures in it when it appears, and creatures it reaches or that enter or end a turn there, make a Dexterity save against 10d8 Fire damage, half on success; each saves only once per turn. The cloud lasts up to 1 minute of concentration.

name: Maze
description: Banish a creature within {{distance:60ft}} into a labyrinth for up to 10 minutes of concentration; there is no initial saving throw. It can take a Study action to escape with a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check; otherwise it returns when the spell ends.

name: Mind Blank
description: For 24 hours, make one creature immune to Psychic damage, the Charmed condition, mind reading, thought manipulation, and Divination that would affect or gather information about it. The protection also foils Wish used for those purposes.

name: Power Word Stun
description: A creature you can see within {{distance:60ft}} is Stunned if it has 150 Hit Points or fewer; otherwise its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. A Stunned target repeats a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

name: Sunburst
description: Sunlight explodes in a {{distance:60ft|adj}}-radius sphere within {{distance:150ft}}. Creatures make a Constitution save against 12d6 Radiant damage, half on success; those that fail are also Blinded for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each turn. The light dispels magical Darkness in the area.

name: Tsunami
description: Raise a water wall up to {{distance:300ft}} long and high and {{distance:50ft}} thick for up to six rounds. Creatures in its area make a Strength save against 6d10 Bludgeoning damage, half on success. Each round it advances {{distance:50ft}}; Huge or smaller creatures it catches face another Strength save against 5d10 Bludgeoning damage. Its height and later damage decrease each round.

name: Astral Projection
material: for each of the spell's targets, one jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and one silver bar worth 100+ GP, all of which the spell consumes
description: Project yourself and up to eight willing creatures into the Astral Plane, leaving unconscious, ageless bodies behind. Each astral form has a silver cord; severing it kills the target. Leaving the Astral Plane pulls the body to the new plane. The spell ends for a target if its body or astral form reaches 0 Hit Points, or you dismiss it. Each target requires a 1,000 GP jacinth and 100 GP silver bar, both consumed.

name: Foresight
description: For 8 hours, one willing creature you touch has Advantage on D20 Tests and attack rolls against it have Disadvantage. The spell ends if you cast it again.

name: Gate
description: Open a portal {{distance:5ft|num}}-{{distance:20ft}} in diameter to a precise location on another plane for up to 1 minute. Creatures can travel through the front of the portal from either plane. When opening it, you can name a particular creature on another plane to transport it immediately to your side; you gain no control over it.

name: Imprisonment
material: a statuette of the target worth 5,000+ GP
description: A creature within {{distance:30ft}} makes a Wisdom save or is confined until dispelled or a trigger you set occurs. Choose Burial, Chaining, Hedged Prison, Minimus Containment, or Slumber. It does not age or need sustenance, cannot teleport, and cannot be located by Divination. A successful save grants immunity to this spell for 24 hours; only a level 9 Dispel Magic can end it early.

name: Mass Heal
description: Distribute up to 700 Hit Points of healing among any creatures you can see within {{distance:60ft}}. Each healed creature is also cured of the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Four meteors strike separate points within {{distance:1mi}}. Each creates a {{distance:40ft|adj}}-radius sphere; creatures there make a Dexterity save against 20d6 Fire plus 20d6 Bludgeoning damage, half on success. Overlapping areas damage a creature only once.

name: Power Word Heal
description: One creature within {{distance:60ft}} regains all Hit Points and is freed from the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned conditions. A Prone target can use its Reaction to stand.

name: Power Word Kill
description: A creature within {{distance:60ft}} dies if it has 100 Hit Points or fewer. If it has more than 100 Hit Points, it instead takes 12d12 Psychic damage; no saving throw.

name: Prismatic Wall
description: Create a seven-layer wall up to {{distance:90ft|num}} by {{distance:30ft}} or a globe up to {{distance:30ft}} in diameter for 10 minutes. Unprotected creatures near it can be Blinded; crossing each layer requires a Dexterity save. The first five layers each deal 12d6 Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison, or Cold damage (half on success); the sixth can Petrify and the seventh can banish. Each layer has its own countermeasure; Antimagic Field cannot suppress the wall.

name: Shapechange
description: For up to 1 hour, become a creature you have seen with CR no higher than your level or CR, other than a Construct or Undead. Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the first form's Hit Points and use its statistics, but retain your Hit Points, Hit Dice, mental abilities, proficiencies, creature type, communication, and Spellcasting feature. A Magic action changes you to another eligible form.

name: Storm of Vengeance
description: A {{distance:300ft|adj}}-radius storm lasts up to 1 minute. At first, creatures below it make a Constitution save or take 2d6 Thunder damage and become Deafened. Turn 2 deals 4d6 Acid; turn 3 calls six bolts for 10d6 Lightning each (Dexterity save for half); turn 4 deals 2d6 Bludgeoning; turns 5-10 deal 1d6 Cold each and make the area heavily obscured and difficult to cross.

name: Time Stop
description: Take 1d4 + 1 extra turns while time is stopped for other creatures. The effect ends early if you affect another creature or something it wears or carries, or if you move more than {{distance:1000ft}} from where you cast the spell.

name: True Polymorph
material: a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke
description: Transform a creature into another creature or a nonmagical object, or an unworn nonmagical object into a creature. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom save to resist. A creature form has CR no higher than the original's level or CR; an object can become a creature of CR 9 or less. Maintaining concentration for the full hour makes the change last until dispelled.

name: True Resurrection
material: diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes
description: Return a creature dead for no more than 200 years, except one that died of old age, to life with full Hit Points. Restore lost organs and limbs, remove poison, contagions, and curses, and return Undead to their original form. If its body no longer exists, speaking its name creates a new one. Consumes 25,000 GP of diamonds.

name: Weird
description: Creatures of your choice in a {{distance:30ft|adj}}-radius sphere make a Wisdom save against 10d10 Psychic damage; success halves it. A failing creature is also Frightened for up to 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of each turn: failure deals 5d10 Psychic damage, success ends the spell for it.

name: Wish
description: Duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower without meeting its casting requirements. Other uses include creating a nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 GP, restoring up to 20 creatures to full health, granting permanent damage resistance or temporary spell immunity, replacing an eligible feat, or rerolling a die from the last round. Greater wishes depend on the GM. Any non-duplicate use causes magical stress: spellcasting damage until a Long Rest, Strength 3 for 2d4 days, and a 33% chance of never casting Wish again.
